caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate vase with a tall, slender neck and a broad, rounded body that narrows toward the base and flares out again at the bottom edge. The vase is decorated with intricate blue patterns on a white background, featuring floral and geometric motifs. The blue design covers the entire surface of the vase, with denser and more elaborate patterns concentrated on the lower and upper portions, while the middle area includes some wider bands of lighter decoration. The neck of the vase is long and slightly flares outward at the opening, which appears uneven or worn. The base shows a thin brownish outline. The drawing includes a faint rectangular border, and the artist's name, “JOHN FISK,” is written in blue capital letters in the lower right corner outside the depiction of the vase. The background is plain and light-colored.
title: Porcelain Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
